record.what_it_does: Customer messaging, support inbox and helpdesk platform with Fin AI agent.
record.auth_notes: Access Token (private apps, own workspace) and OAuth (public apps). Both are sent as Authorization: Bearer. Public apps are required to use OAuth.
record.access_notes: Developer Hub signup creates an app and a development workspace. I didn't confirm the cost. I also didn't find a stated app review requirement for public OAuth apps. Listing in the Intercom App Store may involve review; I didn't verify this.
record.api_breadth_notes: REST API covers contacts, companies, conversations, tickets, articles, data events, tags, notes, teams, admins, data connectors and more. I didn't count operations; it is likely well over 50. I included websocket in api_styles by mistake; the API is REST only, as far as I saw.
record.mcp_notes: US: https://mcp.intercom.com/mcp. EU: https://mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp. AU workspaces aren't supported. It supports OAuth or a bearer token. Fin Operator tools need OAuth.
record.blocker_notes: Possible caveats: the free development workspace may be trial-limited, and public OAuth distribution may need App Store review. Neither was confirmed.

evidence.quote: apps are required to use OAuth rather than asking users for Access Tokens
Intercom hosts a remote MCP server that follows the authenticated remote MCP specification.
a way that you can access real-time notifications about events that happen in your Intercom workspace.

record.needs_human: Confirm that the Developer Hub development workspace is free and not time-limited. Confirm whether public OAuth apps need Intercom review before other workspaces can install them. I didn't find this in the docs I opened. I haven't confirmed the sandbox from a docs page that says so explicitly. The OpenAPI evidence comes from search results, not a page I opened.
